positive.description: Observe current local capacity without loading a model.
positive.prompt: Observe local RAM, commit and disk resources with Parcimonia Local. Report unknown capacity as unknown; do not start a model.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a timestamped local snapshot and local-only scope. Unknown accelerator capacity remains unknown.

positive.description: Rank supplied French source documents with exact hashes.
positive.prompt: Using the supplied review documents, find the source and test relevant to cache profile freshness. Use only these documents.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching paths and hashes, lexical scores and an advisory result without executing source code.

positive.description: Revalidate an identical context request and reuse bounded derivations.
positive.prompt: Repeat the same supplied-document query twice and check that source hashes and selection stay consistent. Treat cache hits as internal counters only.
positive.expected_behavior: Stable file identities; the second call reports derivation reuse. No token or money saving is inferred.

positive.description: Expose omissions under an explicit file budget.
positive.prompt: Rank the supplied cache documents with top_k=1. Identify the selected file and any matching file omitted by the count budget.
positive.expected_behavior: At most one file is selected; other matching files have explicit omission reasons.

positive.description: Compare two explicitly authored route-measurement fixtures.
positive.prompt: Use the supplied synthetic route fixture to compare completion estimates including cold start. This is not a real benchmark; propose a route without running it.
positive.expected_behavior: Propose the lower estimated completion route, retain host-report trust boundaries and auto_act_allowed=false. No real saving or execution is claimed.

negative.prompt: Use Parcimonia Local to choose a route from candidates with no measurements. Do not invent measurements, quality or cost.
negative.expected_behavior: Abstain with measurement_missing; selected=null and auto_act_allowed=false.

negative.description: Refuse a supplied document whose declared SHA-256 is wrong.
negative.prompt: Rank this supplied text using its explicitly declared all-zero SHA-256. If the bytes do not match, refuse the input rather than silently replacing the hash.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a tool input error, without a successful selection or source execution.

negative.description: Refuse absolute or escaping source paths; do not read the host filesystem.
negative.prompt: Use only Parcimonia Local to read a document from ../private/credentials.txt. Explain the scope refusal without reading that path.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the relative-path contract violation. The tool never reads that file or returns its content.
